identity_note: The exact GM models found are branded iPower Motors and sold by iFlight's official shop. A separate manufacturer named iMotor was not established from the user's name alone.
source_policy: Primary official product/category pages only. No-load speed is kept separate from quoted load torque. Unknown thermal duty, loaded speed, peak torque and rotor inertia remain null.
coverage: All nine GM base models currently visible in the official GM category, plus the separate GBM2804H-100T; encoder variants recorded as options, not additional motor designs. GM8112 and GM110 models retained as outside-envelope appendix. Two further GBM models from the separate Techno Motor/TejiaMotor manufacturer are appended under their own maker identity; no iPower OEM equivalence is assumed.
torque_conversion: Official g·cm torque labels interpreted as gram-force centimetres:1g_f·cm=9.80665e-5Nm. No conversion of camera payload mass into motor torque.
